purpose: Paired re-run of moment-cast v6 (incidental figures, narrow missing-cast reports, continuing places, case-insensitive quotes) on the same 100 random verses as the v5 baseline. No images, no production writes.
authorization: Owner approved the two rule changes and this paired re-run on 2026-10-23, within the remaining evaluation allowance.

sampling.frame: Exactly the baseline's 100 verses, in the baseline order (seed 20261023).
sampling.records: Each verse's moment, section, cast entries and stored look are re-read read-only from production; any record that differs from the baseline sample set is reported.

execution: This repository's prepareMoment at the pipeline commit over a fresh in-memory store per sample, exactly as in the baseline. Production adapter, routing and default sampling.
retryPolicy: As in the baseline: one ordinary prepareMoment per sample, no reruns or edits. A provider error, missing usage, uncertain outcome, unexpected request or exhausted reserve stops the run; a sample is not started unless the cap leaves $0.012 of headroom. Untaken samples are excluded from the paired comparison and reported.
rubric: Identical to the baseline rubric (../2026-10-23-random-verse-check/plan.json): U, X, I, F, R, M blockers and N note. U already ignores figures with no cast entry, matching v6.

scoring.scorers: Two fresh, independent subagents with the baseline's instructions; the operator only resolves disagreements, blind, before unblinding.
scoring.packet: Each sample's final plan and first plan reply, deduplicated, plus 40 calibration replies drawn from the baseline's blind replies with a mulberry32 generator seeded 20261024, all shuffled together under new random ids with no version, outcome or role.
scoring.calibration: Agreement between this round's final flags and the baseline's final flags on the 40 calibration replies is reported as a measure of scoring drift between rounds.

comparison: Paired by verse: accepted (stored with no blocker) under v6 versus the baseline. Report both totals, verses improved (rejected to accepted) and regressed (accepted to rejected), and McNemar's exact two-sided p-value on the discordant pairs. Also report flawed-stored, refusals by cause and false refusals, and latency and cost per verse.
